dialogue.zh: 甚至十四个小时。

dialogue.en: Support for the eight-hour work day movement was
dialogue.zh: 支持八小时工作制运动的呼声

dialogue.en: growing rapidly, despite the indifference
dialogue.zh: 迅速高涨，尽管许多工会领袖

dialogue.en: and hostility of many union leaders,
dialogue.zh: 对此漠不关心甚至充满敌意，

dialogue.en: and by April 1886, 250,000 workers were involved in
dialogue.zh: 到1886年4月，已有二十五万工人参与了

dialogue.en: the May Day movement.
dialogue.zh: 五一运动。

dialogue.en: Previous legislative attempts to improve working
dialogue.zh: 此前通过立法改善工作

dialogue.en: conditions had failed,
dialogue.zh: 条件的尝试均告失败，

dialogue.en: so labor organizers took drastic measures.
dialogue.zh: 因此劳工组织者采取了激进措施。

dialogue.en: They passed a resolution stating that eight hours
dialogue.zh: 他们通过了一项决议，规定八小时

dialogue.en: would constitute a legal day's work.
dialogue.zh: 将构成一个法定工作日。

dialogue.en: And, on May First 1886, the resolution took effect.
dialogue.zh: 并且，在1886年5月1日，该决议生效了。

dialogue.en: B: Cool! Is that why we only work eight hours now?
dialogue.zh: B: 太酷了！这就是我们现在只工作八小时的原因吗？

dialogue.en: A: Yes! But the happy ending came at a high price.
dialogue.zh: A: 是的！但这个幸福结局付出了高昂的代价。

dialogue.en: On May third, 1886, police fired into a crowd of
dialogue.zh: 1886年5月3日，警察对

dialogue.en: strikers at the McCormick Reaper Works Factory,
dialogue.zh: McCormick Reaper Works工厂的罢工者人群开火，

dialogue.en: killing four and wounding many.
dialogue.zh: 造成四人死亡，多人受伤。

dialogue.en: A mass meeting was called for the next day to protest
dialogue.zh: 次日召开了一场群众集会以抗议

dialogue.en: the brutality.
dialogue.zh: 这一暴行。

dialogue.en: B: And then what happened?
dialogue.zh: B: 然后呢？后来发生了什么？

dialogue.en: A: Well, as we say, the rest is history...
dialogue.zh: A: 嗯，正如我们常说的，后来的事大家都知道了……
